content: {"rules": ["Forecast models consistently overestimate prices in early cycles and underperform during sharp downturns.", "Sentiment spikes correlate with price reversals, especially when negative sentiment precedes sharp declines.", "Model forecasts show persistent lag in capturing true price momentum, particularly after sentiment shifts.", "High sentiment positivity often precedes price corrections, indicating model overconfidence in upward trends.", "Models exhibit mean-reversion bias in later cycles, underestimating downward momentum after initial peaks.", "Forecast accuracy drops when sentiment is volatile or mixed, suggesting sentiment interaction is critical for calibration.", "Models fail to anticipate sudden price drops when sentiment turns negative without clear trend reversal signals.", "Forecast overshoots are common in early cycles, but models correct later with diminishing accuracy as price volatility increases."]}
